name: LAST ONE
description: Last One (also known as Last Card) is a popular shedding-type card game from the Crazy Eights family. Played across many Commonwealth countries, particularly New Zealand and Australia, it involves players trying to empty their hands by matching cards on a central pile. The game is famous for its 'special cards' that force opponents to draw or skip turns, and the mandatory requirement to announce 'Last One' when holding a single card.

content.text: Last One (also known as Last Card) is a popular shedding-type card game from the Crazy Eights family. Played across many Commonwealth countries, particularly New Zealand and Australia, it involves players trying to empty their hands by matching cards on a central pile. The game is famous for its 'special cards' that force opponents to draw or skip turns, and the mandatory requirement to announce 'Last One' when holding a single card.

Dates to the early 20th century as a localized expansion of Crazy Eights. It gained popularity in New Zealand, Australia, the UK, and parts of the United States as a faster, more aggressive social game.
Standard 52-card deck + 2 Jokers. Jokers are typically 'Draw 5' or 'Draw 6' penalty cards.
Standard deck and a flat surface.
Each player receives 7 cards (or 4-9 cards at dealer's choice). One card is turned up to start the discard pile. Remaining cards form the stock.

items.text: Crazy Eights: The American standard variant, typically with fewer special cards (usually just 8s as wilds).
Mau-Mau: German variant with slightly different special card rules.
UNO: Commercial proprietary version with custom cards and standardized rules.
Taki: Israeli variant with 'Super' cards and additional special actions.
Switch: UK variant with Black Jack (draw 5) and Red Jack (cancel draw) rules.
